title: Distinguish SSE connection totals from finite-response size observations
outcome: Output-size diagnostics identify SSE stream-lifetime totals separately from finite HTTP body sizes while retaining per-frame observations and observation-only delivery semantics.
acceptance: SSE stream-lifetime totals have a distinct fixed diagnostic stage or family from finite HTTP response bodies, with per-frame SSE size observations retained.
Tests distinguish many small SSE frames from one large finite body without changing bytes, stream behavior, or introducing collection, copies, caps or waits.
